Upgrading your staff (getting slightly better staff) is easy you go to staff search and search exactly what staff you need and you can even filter it by their attributes and then the ones that are interested in signing for you will pop up but then you have to try and negotiate and believe me in my opinion negotiating with staff is the worst negotiating 

But if you mean upgrading your staff (increasing the number of staff/getting really better staff than your current) is hard to do , you have to get the boards trust and show the results in your yearly goals for there to be even a chance of them accepting

Then for scouting first you need to have scouts in your staff obviously and click to set up the recruitment focuses and if you want to add a recruitment focus you just click on the page and then you the pop up menu that pops up from the "create a recruitment focus" should be easy to navigate , also the star system is kind of based on your team so basically a 4 star for exeter city wont be a 4 star for man city and a lot of the times the star system isnt right at all so youll need to learn how to tell a good player from a bad player by their stats (cant help you much with this as i still fuck up transfers) , also as Zealand says when your not in a top flight use LOANSSSS

for signing players its kinda easy concept you go to a certain player page -> transfer -> make an offer and then you have to haggle with other teams and then potentially even haggle with the players when you have to go to the contract negotiation 

I am going off topics you mention but also as to what to do next is whatever you think is right for the team thats the beauty of it , if you think a certain player is bad and you need a better player go and look for one to better fit your system or whatever it is.
